title: Statutory Charges, Facility Fees and Utility Charges on Hotel Stays
content:
This determination governs the statutory and mandatory charges raised on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range.

**A clause no longer in force.** The clause reading "Occupancy tax and city tax are applied to the room total alone, night by night, and never to optional extras or to the agency service fee" is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis on which the statutory charge for the last night of a stay is worked out. The clauses that follow stand as clauses in force.

**The facility fee.** The property facility fee is charged per room per night on every plan that does not waive it, and is charged whether or not the guest uses the facilities it covers.

**Parking and internet.** Parking is charged per room per night at the plan's amount and is never charged where the guest declares no vehicle. In-room internet is charged per day only on a plan that does not include it.

**The basis taxes are measured on.** Taxes are calculated after any club or corporate discount has been applied to the room rate, so the discount reduces the tax as well. The basis is accordingly the room total after discounts and before optional extras. Where a tax rate changes between booking and stay, the rate in force on the night stayed applies, because tax follows the night and not the booking.

*Hypothetical arithmetic on the basis.* Where a room rate of 200.00 USD carries a discount of 10 percent, the discounted room figure of 180.00 USD is the basis; occupancy tax at the plan's rate of 12.5 percent on that basis is 22.50 USD, and city tax at 4 percent on the same basis is 7.20 USD.

superseded_clauses: Occupancy tax and city tax are applied to the room total alone, night by night, and never to optional extras or to the agency service fee.
